subject: Media Literacy
title: Advertising and Gender Roles
description: A 60-second lesson on Advertising and Gender Roles.

hook.text: A 1950s ad shows a woman delighted by a new vacuum. Today's ads show her delighted by yogurt. Progress?

buildup.text: Advertising has historically reinforced gender stereotypes — women as homemakers, men as breadwinners.

discovery.text: Even 'empowerment' campaigns often reduce feminism to a brand message while selling beauty products.

twist.text: Dove ran 'Real Beauty' ads while its parent company Unilever ran sexist Axe body spray commercials.

climax.text: Ads don't reflect society. They shape it — reinforcing who we think men and women should be.

punchline.text: Ads sell gender roles as often as they sell products.

quiz.question: What contradiction existed with Dove's 'Real Beauty' campaign?
options: Its parent company also ran sexist ads for other brands
